title.fr: Gravitation universelle (loi de Newton, champ vectoriel)

formula: F = G · m₁·m₂ / r²   avec  G = 6,67·10⁻¹¹ N·m²/kg²
sketch:
Observe: SVG canvas with two spherical masses m₁, m₂ (draggable,
radius encodes mass). Attractive force vector F₁₂ on each mass,
length ∝ |F| = G·m₁m₂/r². HUD: r (in scaled units — Earth radii or
AU), m₁, m₂ (kg or Earth-masses), |F| (N). Student drags either mass
and scales m via slider. Experiment: given target |F| between Earth
and a satellite, pick orbital radius. Evaluate: force arrow hidden —
student picks r to match a target |F| (readout kept). Wrinkle:
G = 6.67·10⁻¹¹ baked in; problem framed in astronomical units to
make numbers tractable. Explicitly compared to Coulomb structure.
3ème-level: full vector field-theory treatment.
